exact_theorem.source: Step45 original six-pair spherical C and Step46 original f-lapse/f-momentum primary elimination; Step48 exact center compatibility
symbolic_checks: With S_i=r L_i, pLi=r² U_i(s), pSi=r V_i(s), dust p_i=r² rho_i(s), z=r z1(s), all regular parity inputs, C/r² is exactly even under r→-r
After original primary leading conditions Sg'(0)=a,Sf'(0)=b,pSg/r=2Pg,pLg'/r=2Pg, the complete center C/r² is affine in W=pLf'/r with nonzero ∂Cbar/∂W=-m² Mg² Astar/(2 Mf² b)
W=G(s,U), G(0,U)=3U0-U for arbitrary nearby U, U0=Mf² b*(Pg/(Mg² a)-2 z1)
s U_s=-(3/2)(U-U0)+(s/2)R(s,U), R analytic locally under explicitly named source-analyticity and regular-denominator assumptions

Bounded analytic local solution exists uniquely by Volterra contraction on sufficiently small s≥0, with kernel w(s)=[1/(2s^(3/2))]∫_0^s t^(3/2)R(t,U0+w(t)) dt. Homogeneous U~C s^(-3/2) (=P/r singular) excluded.
exact_theorem.nondegenerate_chart: a>0,b>0,Mf²>0,Mg²>0,m²>0,J(y)>0, Sf_prime>0, sqrt roots and dust coefficients positive; compact smearing or controlled boundary
exact_theorem.scope: Conditional mathematical local C=0 constrained initial-data branch for analytic prescribed metric/g fields and dust phases, NOT an analytically constructed global radial solution or any time-evolving 4D solution

numeric_center_shoot.normalization: P=pLf=r² U(s); U0 exactly determined by Step48 Frobenius center condition
numeric_center_shoot.method: Use pLf(eps)=U0 eps² (+ U1 eps⁴ for order1), integrate exact symbolic Step46 RHS with SciPy solve_ivp from eps>0 to .85; 2e-12 relative, 1e-18 absolute, maximum step .012. Reference eps=.001 order1, NOT rigorous error enclosure.
numeric_center_shoot.observed: Without U1, endpoint cutoff error falls ~32 when eps halves (empirical eps^5); with U1, error initially decreases ~128 (eps^7) then stalls at double rounding. This strongly supports regular-center construction, not a global numerical error theorem.
